title: Grant
description: Claims of an agent grant: a short-lived JWT access token (RFC 9068, header typ at+jwt) the STS issues for one task, bound to the sidecar's key. The agent's model never sees it. For a user task, sub is the user and act the agent; for a service task the agent is both, so sub equals client_id.

iss.description: The STS that issued the grant.

sub.description: Whom the agent acts for: the user, unique across every identity provider the box trusts, or, for a service task, the agent itself.

sub_id.description: Where the user's identity came from. Present exactly when sub is a user, that is, when sub differs from client_id.

aud.description: Resource servers that accept the grant: exactly the locations of authorization_details.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the grant was issued to: the agent, as the identity it authenticated with names it, or its agent name for a registration identity (RFC 9068).

cnf.description: The DPoP key the grant is bound to (RFC 9449 §6.1). Every grant from the box's own STS carries one; it is optional here only for clients that cannot hold a key, such as hosted agents run by a vendor.

jkt.description: JWK SHA-256 thumbprint of the key (RFC 7638), base64url.

task.description: The task this grant serves, as it was started.

initiator.description: The application that started a user task. A service task has none: the agent started it.

started.description: How the task began, for policy and for the record.

confirmed_at.description: When the user confirmed this exact task. Present when the task type required confirmation.

status.description: Where to check revocation (Token Status List).
